_comment: 인스타 캐러셀 9장 예제 — 에이나우 'Claude Code 7가지 꿀팁' 실증 버전. 본인 주제에 맞게 slides[].prompt 를 수정하세요. common_style 은 디자인 DNA 라 놔두는 걸 권장.
common_style: Instagram carousel slide design, 4:5 aspect ratio (1080x1350 px). Trendy magazine editorial style, premium dark. - Background: deep black #0B0B0E with ONE soft warm radial glow (top-right, orange tinted, subtle) and a very subtle film grain texture. - Primary accent: warm orange gradient from #F0956B to #CF5C3F (used for headline keyword, thin progress bar at very top, underline bar). - Primary text: pure white #FFFFFF. - Secondary text: white 45% opacity. - Labels: rounded pill chip with thin orange border, small glowing orange dot, uppercase letter-spaced text. - Signature: huge outlined ghost number in background top-right (outline only, white 7% opacity). - Footer on every slide: small letter-spaced brand name bottom-left, page number like '02 / 09' bottom-right (current number orange). - Typography: Korean sans-serif (Pretendard-like), oversized extra-bold headlines with tight letter-spacing, monospace only for code/numbers. - Cards: dark surface with 1px white 9% hairline border, 24px rounded corners. - Layout: generous whitespace, left-aligned, trendy tech magazine feel. - Mood: professional, developer-focused, clean, modern, premium.

slides.prompt: COVER SLIDE for carousel titled "Claude Code Guide". Layout: - Orange pill chip label "CLAUDE CODE GUIDE" (thin border, glowing dot) at bottom-left. - Huge extra-bold Korean headline: "해커톤 우승자의" (white), then "꿀팁 7가지" (orange gradient). - Short orange gradient underline bar below headline. - Subtitle in gray: "저장 필수. 하나씩 적용해보세요." - Huge outlined ghost number "07" in background top-right. - Bottom-right small pill chip "SWIPE →". - Huge empty top area (composition breathing room).

TIP 01 slide. - Top-left orange pill chip label "TIP 01". - Ghost outlined number "01" in background top-right. - Korean headline (white + "CLAUDE.md" in orange): "프로젝트 루트에 CLAUDE.md 하나면 응답이 달라진다". - Middle: ASCII-art style folder tree in monospace font highlighting CLAUDE.md in orange. - Bottom tags in gray: "기술 스택   코딩 컨벤션   빌드 명령어".

TIP 02 slide. Korean headline: "코딩 전에 Plan Mode 먼저" ("Plan Mode" in orange). Middle: 3 large circular icons in a horizontal row — 분석 → 계획(orange, glowing) → 실행. Below circles: dark pill button "Shift + Tab". Bottom caption gray: "계획 없는 코딩은 시간 낭비."

TIP 03 slide. Korean headline: "서브에이전트로 병렬 처리" ("병렬 처리" in orange). Middle: 2x2 grid of 4 dark terminal-card panels (agent-1 lint / agent-2 test / agent-3 build / agent-4 docs), green checks. Bottom comparison: "순차 40분" (struck through gray) → "병렬 12분" (big orange monospace).

TIP 04 slide. Korean headline: "대화 길어지면 /compact" ("/compact" in orange). Middle: huge orange monospace text "/compact" with subtle gray caption "지금까지 작업 내용 요약해줘". Bottom: two horizontal progress bars — Before 92% (orange) / After 24% (green). Caption gray: "30턴 넘으면 반드시."

TIP 05 slide. Korean headline: "Worktree로 안전하게 실험해라" ("Worktree" in orange). Body: two contrasting blocks — Top: X mark + "main에서 직접 실험 → 망하면 되돌리기 힘듦". Bottom: arrow + "Worktree로 격리된 복사본 / 성공 → merge / 실패 → 삭제 / 리스크 제로" (마지막 줄 green). Caption: "원본은 그대로, 실험은 자유롭게".

TIP 06 slide. Korean headline: "나만의 슬래시 커맨드" ("슬래시 커맨드" in orange). Middle: dark rounded-corner command palette UI mock with 4 rows (/review /test /refactor /doc). Bottom monospace: ".claude/commands/review.md" with caption "프롬프트를 .md 파일로 저장하면 끝".

TIP 07 slide. Korean headline: "Hooks로 품질을 자동화해라" ("Hooks" in orange). Middle: vertical flow diagram of 5 circular badges — H(orange) Hook: PreToolUse / L(yellow) Lint+Type / T(green) Test / S(blue) Security / OK(bold orange) 통과 시에만 반영. Caption: "Hook 한 번 설정 = 영구 가드레일".

OUTRO / closing slide. Vertically centered, left-aligned: - Orange pill chip label "SAVE & SHARE". - Large extra-bold Korean headline: "하나씩 적용하면 체감이 확 됩니다" (with "확" in large orange gradient). - Short orange gradient underline bar. - Gray subtitle: "지금 저장해두면 필요할 때 바로 씁니다." - ONE orange gradient pill CTA button with bookmark icon: "이 캐러셀 저장하기". - Soft centered warm glow, ghost word "SAVE" outlined in background bottom-right. Most of canvas empty dark space (premium editorial breathing room).
